protocol.name: senkos_shell_v1
protocol.copyright: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT (built into Weston, like the shell)

interface.name: senkos_shell_v1

description.summary: the launcher's control of Weston's senkos shell

interface.description:
Only the launcher may bind this (Weston's senkos-shell.so lets the user shell and root bind it).
Each of the launcher's toplevels is in the launcher layer, above the apps' toplevels, fullscreen, unless it's an overlay. The layer is shown and focused when one of them maps, or after show. It's hidden on hide, or when the root of a new toplevel tree of an app maps; the app's top toplevel then gets the focus.

request.name: set_overlay
request.description: Sent before the first commit of the surface's toplevel; again to move it. The surface is drawn above every other one at its own size, at the edges anchored, margin pixels in, centred on the others. It never gets the focus, so the app under it keeps running and keeps the keys.

request.name: show

description.summary: the launcher's layer on top, focused

request.description: At the next commit of one of its toplevels, so what was on it when it hid is never shown again.

description.summary: the launcher's layer hidden, the app focused

request.name: show_app

description.summary: an app's windows shown, under the launcher's layer

request.description: The newest toplevel tree of the clients in this process group, the apps' tree shown from now (the focus once the launcher's layer hides); the windows it had stay as they were, nothing is mapped again. Nothing when none of them has a toplevel (Xwayland's windows are the Xwayland server's, not the app's).

request.name: set_refresh

description.summary: each output to the mode at its size of this rate

request.description: The rate in mHz, as wl_output's mode gives it. A rate an output has no mode for changes nothing. Kept by the shell, set again at each start.

request.name: set_screen
request.description: Off: nothing is drawn and no frame events are sent until on again.

event.name: idle_inhibited

description.summary: whether a shown surface keeps the screen on

event.description: Sent at bind and at each change: 1 while a surface shown (the launcher's while its layer is, else the shown tree of an app's) or one of its subsurfaces has a zwp_idle_inhibitor_v1.
